title: The Tooth Fairy
hook: 吃意大利面的时候，Peppa 掉了一颗牙。晚上牙仙子会来吗？

cells.q: What were Peppa and George eating?
cells.a: They were eating spaghetti, their favourite food.
cells.cn: 他们在吃最爱的意大利面。

cells.a: One of her teeth came out! “Where did that come from?”
cells.cn: 她掉了一颗牙——“这是从哪儿来的？”

cells.a: The Tooth Fairy will pay Peppa a visit tonight.
She said, “I want to be a Tooth Fairy!”
She asked, “Peppa, what are you doing?”
She thought, “This Tooth Fairy is very late!”
cells.cn: 她觉得：“牙仙子来得也太晚了！”

cells.a: She asked, “George, can you hear something?”
The Tooth Fairy arrived and took the tooth.
cells.cn: 牙仙子终于来了，把牙取走了。

cells.q: What did the Tooth Fairy leave?
cells.a: She left a coin for Peppa under the pillow.
cells.cn: 她在枕头下给 Peppa 留了一枚硬币。

helper.keywords: tooth, fairy, coin, pillow, late, visit
helper.actions: eat, lose, wait, hear, arrive, leave

opener: Today I watched Peppa Pig. This episode is “The Tooth Fairy”.
ending: In the end, Peppa finds a coin under her pillow. My favourite part is ______.
